BaseProfile.notes: Canonical 120 x 80 x 10 body fixture; lowers to SolidBuildSpec, and executes through the tested CadQuery backend, and passes validated STEP export/reimport witnesses.

Hole.notes: Through and blind interval semantics lower to SolidBuildSpec; STEP export/reimport is validated through the same resolved SolidBuildSpec.

CircularHolePattern.notes: EngineeringModel path expands through SpatialModel and lowers to SolidBuildSpec; the separate CadDocument backend is not the source of truth; STEP is an exchange artifact.

GridHolePattern.notes: EngineeringModel spatial/projection/visibility/drawing coverage and backend-neutral lowering and tested CadQuery execution are present and pass validated STEP export/reimport witnesses.

CornerHolePattern.notes: EngineeringModel spatial/projection/visibility/drawing coverage and backend-neutral lowering and tested CadQuery execution are present and pass validated STEP export/reimport witnesses.

ConstructionCircle.notes: Reference-only construction geometry; no manufacturing operation is emitted. No manufacturing command is exposed to the Phase 10.5 workflow.

Slot.notes: Phase 12.3 typed through Slot/oblong cut (overall_length, width, center, orientation) retains exact Line+Arc spatial geometry and drawing semantics. Phase 13.4 supports typed SolidOperation::SlotCut carrying the exact derived ClosedProfileSpec contour through the shared CadQuery builder and validated STEP reimport/equivalence path; no Python reconstruction, tessellation, or bbox fallback. Slot patterns and NL Slot remain unsupported.

Fillet.notes: Stored intent vocabulary exists; no EngineeringModel-to-solid bridge is implemented. Natural-language proposal/clarification/preview is fail-closed because the feature is unsupported.

CircularBaseProfile.notes: Phase 13.1 typed circular base is supported through SpatialModel → SolidBuildSpec → exact CadQuery circle extrusion → STEP export/reimport equivalence and validated artifact delivery. Non-zero centers and resolved cylindrical cuts are preserved; Composite and Slot manufacturing are enabled in Phases 13.3C and 13.4, respectively.

RoundedRectangle.notes: Phase 13.2 typed RoundedRectangle source (center, width, height, corner_radius) is preserved in SpatialModel as typed resolved profile semantics, lowered to SolidBuildSpec, built as an exact CadQuery rounded extrusion, and delivered only after STEP reimport/equivalence validation. Composite and Slot manufacturing are enabled in Phases 13.3C and 13.4, respectively.

CompositeProfile.notes: Phase 13.3C: typed Engineering/Spatial Composite identity gates exact lowering to generic Line/Arc ClosedProfile, native CadQuery wire/face/+Z extrusion, STEP reimport/equivalence validation, and unchanged validated artifact delivery. Segment order, explicit arc direction, major arcs, translation, concavity, typed cylindrical cuts, and upstream-resolved patterns are preserved; no Composite DTO/backend, inference, tessellation, or bbox substitution. Full-circle and exactly-180-degree ambiguous arcs are forbidden; inner loops/multiple contours remain deferred.

Polygon.notes: Phase 13.3B typed Polygon source identity is preserved through SpatialModel and lowered in canonical order to the existing exact line-only ClosedProfile SolidBuildSpec. Existing CadQuery extrusion, typed cylindrical cuts, STEP reimport/equivalence, and validated artifact delivery are reused; there is no Polygon DTO/backend, tessellation, bbox substitution, or manufacturing recanonicalization. Composite and Slot manufacturing are enabled in Phases 13.3C and 13.4, respectively. NL Polygon and per-edge dimensions remain deferred.

separate_cad_document_backend.notes: CadDocument 1.0 / feature_graph_v1 remains a separate, reachable compatibility backend and mutable CAD editing state. It retains BREP/STL/GLB/SVG/source JSON derivatives, but formal STEP export and download are disabled; CadDocument has no EngineeringModel bridge and cannot provide formal STEP authority.

solid_build_spec_backend.notes: EngineeringModel is source truth. AicadProject v1 persists only metadata plus EngineeringModel; POST /api/engineering/export/step runs the real Rust→Spatial/Manufacturing→CadQuery/OCP→STEP/reimport chain and delivers the exact validated bytes. No STEP→EngineeringModel reconstruction or server artifact store.
